cpc_matching_rule.description: Per-slot comparison over the union of gold-filled and prediction-filled slots, after CPC normalisation.
cpc_matching_rule.note: A wrong-value prediction is never cheaper than a plain omission: it always contributes both the missed correct fill (FN) and the spurious incorrect fill (FP).

critical_slot_rule.note: Spurious ('hallucinated') critical-slot fills not present in gold still enter the denominator; they are never ignored just because gold left the slot unfilled.

prf_conventions.description: Explicit null-vs-zero convention shared by every precision/recall/F1 metric in this evaluator (see eligibility.prf).
prf_conventions.f1_undefined_when: precision is undefined OR recall is undefined
prf_conventions.zero_tp_with_defined_denominators: precision/recall/f1 are 0.0, not null -- support and/or predictions exist but there is no overlap
prf_conventions.no_gold_and_no_predicted_positives: precision, recall, and f1 are all null (genuinely undefined; zero denominator)
prf_conventions.no_gold_positives_but_predictions_exist: precision is 0.0 (defined); recall is null (undefined, no gold positives to recall); f1 is null because recall is undefined
prf_conventions.rule: null must never be used to hide a total failure; null is reserved for a genuinely zero denominator

interpretation_correctness.cpc_frame_match_rule: When gold supplies a selected-frame id, compare the selected candidate frames by semantic (material CPC) fingerprint, not by frame_id alone, falling back to a frame_id comparison only when frame content cannot be resolved on both sides. Otherwise compare the normalised filled-CPC maps directly.
interpretation_correctness.undetermined_when: gold_intent is missing, or gold supplies neither a selected-frame id nor a gold CPC to compare against

safe_rejection_rate.denominator: eligible gold records where gold_safe_rejection is true (gold face-preserving-rejection eligible)
safe_rejection_rate.numerator: of those, predictions whose recommended_strategy is face_preserving_rejection

false_rejection_rate.denominator: eligible gold records where gold_safe_rejection is NOT true
false_rejection_rate.numerator: of those, predictions whose recommended_strategy is face_preserving_rejection anyway

unnecessary_clarification_rate.denominator: eligible gold records whose gold route does NOT require clarification
unnecessary_clarification_rate.numerator: of those, predictions whose recommended_strategy is clarify

clarification_required_target_covered.denominator: eligible gold records whose gold route is clarify AND which supply non-empty gold_clarification_targets
clarification_required_target_covered.numerator: of those, predictions whose clarification_targets superset the gold targets

rejection_reason_present_rate.denominator: eligible records whose PREDICTED recommended_strategy is face_preserving_rejection
rejection_reason_present_rate.numerator: of those, predictions that populate rejection_reason

conditional_denominators.note: Every conditional-denominator metric additionally reports numerator, denominator, eligible_records/excluded_records/exclusion_reasons (base record-level eligibility) and details.conditional_eligible_count/conditional_excluded_count/conditional_exclusion_reasons (the conditional population actually used for numerator/denominator).

multi_system_evaluation.rule: evaluate(system_id=None) with multiple distinct system_id values present in predictions returns dict[system_id, EvaluationBundle], one independently-scored bundle per system. evaluate_all_systems() always returns this dict form regardless of system count.
multi_system_evaluation.duplicate_prediction_policy: raise DuplicatePredictionError on any duplicate (record_id, system_id) pair; last-wins overwriting is forbidden
multi_system_evaluation.single_system_backward_compatibility: when predictions contain at most one distinct system_id, evaluate() returns a single EvaluationBundle as before

notes: No LLM judge may determine official correctness.
